outgoingFlows.description: Infection from infectious mosquito bite leading to symptomatic disease, probability depends on infection-blocking immunity and clinical immunity
Infection from infectious mosquito bite leading to asymptomatic infection (due to clinical immunity reducing probability of symptoms)
Treatment of symptomatic cases with antimalarials
Progression from symptomatic to asymptomatic infection in absence of treatment or after treatment failure
Progression from patent asymptomatic infection to subpatent infection, rate depends on blood-stage immunity
Recovery from subpatent infection to susceptible state
Successful parasite clearance followed by prophylactic protection dependent on drug half-life
Treatment failure, entering asymptomatic infection state
Loss of prophylactic drug protection, return to susceptible state
Mosquito becomes infected after biting an infectious human (D, A, U, or T states with different infectivity levels)
Completion of extrinsic incubation period in mosquito, becoming infectious

uncertainty_analysis.methodologyNotes: This task is **parameter uncertainty quantification**: documenting uncertainty about **numerical parameter values** in the .compmodel (not structural or stochastic uncertainty). Confidence is **mostly Unknown** unless a small built-in heuristic matches the disease name (COVID-19, Malaria, HIV) and parameter name substrings — assigning High/Medium/Low requires curated literature ranges or expert review; see Phase 1 README (Validity & limitations).
